transcript: Mr. Warren: Good grief! I'm ruined!
Maj. Thorne: What's the matter, Mr. Warren?
Mr. Warren: Some hackers found out the password of my robotic vacuum cleaner!
Maj. Thorne: Relax, that doesn't sound so bad.
Mr. Warren: But it's the same password I use in all my devices and accounts! Now they own my whole life!

fail_fact.title: Your vacuum knows your WiFi password
text: In July 2026, a security researcher demonstrated a serious vulnerability in widely used robot vacuums.

Depending on the model, an attacker could remotely control the vacuum, access its camera, retrieve maps of the home — and recover the WiFi password stored by the device in plaintext. More than 1.5 million devices were at risk.
Smart appliances are computers. They need computer-level security.
